parameters.value: Water Curtain nozzle, 63mm size with deflector Plate fitted with Male Instantaneous inlet coupling , suitable for use with 63 mm size hose and giving semi circular spray pattern for radiant heat protection., The water curtain patterns should be uniform over curtain.
Stainless Steel Conforming to Grade 1 or 4 of IS 3444:1999 (latest amendments)

All fitting shall be good workmanship, finish and free from all burrs and sharp edges The forging and casting shall be sound and free from porosity, blow holes, scales, cracks and other imperfections and shall not be repaired or filled so as to hide casting defects. The water way of the fittings shall have a smooth finish.
Any damage and / or manufacturing defects to the supplied material will not be accepted.

Each water curtain shall be clearly and permanently marked /embossed on SS plate with the following: • Manufacturer's/Supplier’s name • Year of Manufacture • Serial Number • Capacity in LPM • Operating pressure
All external surfaces shall be prepared properly & provided with paint system compatible to MOC of Deflector Plate
Vendor shall furnish Manufacture's test certificates as evidence for having used materials for various components as per specifications.
Flow test : Minimum 900 (LPM) at 7 kg /cm2 pressure with approximate semi circular pattern : 18 Mtr (min) width and 6 Mtrs (min) Height .
